title: Lung Motion Estimation Using Non-Rigid Point Cloud Registration
author: Fan Rao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qrhdv36
materials: Initial the local affine transformation parameters X.

steps.title: Extract Point Clouds
steps.instruction: Extract dense point clouds F and R from 4DCT images at different phases to represent the lung surface status at different times.

steps.title: Simplify Source Point Cloud
steps.instruction: Simplify point cloud F to point cloud F‘, ensuring the scale of F‘ is approximately 4000.

steps.title: Calculate Connectivity Matrix
steps.instruction: Calculate the connectivity matrix M from point cloud F‘.

steps.title: Process Target Point Cloud
steps.instruction: Calculate normal vector information N from point cloud R, then simplify both point cloud R and its normal vector information N to R‘ and N‘.

substeps.instruction: Calculate normal vector information N from point cloud R
Simplify point cloud R and normal vector information N to R‘ and N‘, ensuring the scale of R‘ is approximately 6000

steps.title: Prepare Non-Rigid Registration
steps.instruction: Input point cloud F‘ (source), connectivity matrix M, point cloud R‘ (target), and normal vector information N‘ into the non-rigid registration procedure.

steps.title: Initialize Parameters
steps.instruction: Initialize the weight value α and the stiffness matrix G.

steps.title: Optimize Transformation Parameters
steps.instruction: Update local affine transformation parameters using stochastic gradient descent optimization by calculating the derivative of the objective function.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the derivative of the objective function relative to the transformation parameters
Update local affine transformation parameters using stochastic gradient descent
Repeat the process until convergence criteria are met

steps.title: Export Results
steps.instruction: Output the final local affine transformation parameters and the transformed points.
